title: Weather Radar

fields.label: Function
fields.value: An interactable radar that will display when the next weather event will occur, as well as what that event will be !

body:
Weather Radar



Type: Structures

The Weather Radar is a purchasable structure found in the Gizmo's Observatory.

Once placed, if you interact with the radar it will tell you the next weather event/current weather.

The radar has its own chat name (Noah The Radar) and will have a text bubble on top of the radar when telling you the next weather event and current.

The weather radar can be activated through the use of an Interactor and can be automated by connecting a Weather Sensor to an Interactor to it.
